method: Recorded historical source hashes are resolved against Git blob bytes. Exact bytes are preferred; documented canonical LF normalization is used explicitly where required. Commit fields locate content only and do not identify an execution checkout.
limitations: A matching source blob does not prove execution used a clean checkout or only these files.
Recorded source inventories can be partial; missing files and run metadata are not reconstructed.
Current source paths may differ after migration; the Git locator preserves original bytes.

records.normalization: replace CRLF with LF, then remaining CR with LF
